arxiv-2110-13180.description: Abstract Simulating quantum imaginary-time evolution (QITE) is a significant promise of quantum computation. However, the known algorithms are either probabilistic (repeat until success) with unpractically small success probabilities or coherent (quantum amplitude amplification) with circuit depths and ancillary-qubit numbers unrealistically large in the mid-term.

arxiv-2211-14680.description: Abstract Machine learning models are gaining increasing popularity in the domain of fluid dynamics for their potential to accelerate the production of high-fidelity computational fluid dynamics data. arxiv-2310-06687.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jau-Uei Chen, Tamás L. Horváth, Tan Bui-Thanh. We present a divergence-free and H ⁡ ( d ​ i ​ v ) H\left(div\right) -conforming hybridized discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) method and a computationally efficient variant called embedded-HDG (E-HDG) for solving stationary incompressible viso-resistive magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) equations. The proposed E-HDG approach uses continuous facet unknowns for the vector-valued solutions (velocity and magnetic fields) while it uses discontinuous facet unknowns for the scalar variable (pressure and magnetic pressure).

arxiv-2402-05671.title: Representation of the Terrestrial Carbon Cycle in CMIP6
arxiv-2402-05671.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . Improvements in the representation of the land carbon cycle in Earth system models participating in the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6 (CMIP6) include interactive treatment of both the carbon and nitrogen cycles, improved photosynthesis, and soil hydrology. To assess the impact of these model developments on aspects of the global carbon cycle, the Earth System Model Evaluation Tool (ESMValTool) is expanded to compare CO 2 concentration and emission driven historical simulations from CMIP5 and CMIP6 to observational data sets.

arxiv-2410-20965.title: Simultaneous Unlearning of Multiple Protected User Attributes From Variational Autoencoder Recommenders Using Adversarial Training
arxiv-2410-20965.creator: Gustavo Escobedo, Christian Ganhör, Stefan Brandl, Mirjam Augstein, Markus Schedl
arxiv-2410-20965.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gustavo Escobedo, Christian Ganhör, Stefan Brandl, Mirjam Augstein, Markus Schedl. In widely used neural network-based collaborative filtering models, users’ history logs are encoded into latent embeddings that represent the users’ preferences. In this setting, the models are capable of mapping users’ protected attributes (e.g., gender or ethnicity) from these user embeddings even without explicit access to them, resulting in models that may treat specific demographic user groups unfairly and raise privacy issues.

arxiv-2501-03424.title: Soergel bimodules and Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials
arxiv-2501-03424.creator: ethan eugene wynner
arxiv-2501-03424.description: Abstract Abstract This paper presents an exposition of Soergel bimodules, the categorification of Hecke algebras, and their applications to various topics in Kazhdan-Lusztig theory. We ultimately exposit a few of Soergel’s main results, which allowed him to give alternative proofs, using his theory, of the Kazhdan-Lusztig conjectures.

arxiv-2503-19043.title: Enhancing Symbolic Regression with Quality-Diversity and Physics-Inspired Constraints
arxiv-2503-19043.creator: Jean-Philippe Bruneton jpbruneton@gmail.com
arxiv-2503-19043.description: Abstract This paper presents QDSR, an advanced symbolic Regression (SR) system that integrates genetic programming (GP), a quality-diversity (QD) algorithm, and a dimensional analysis (DA) engine. Our method focuses on exact symbolic recovery of known expressions from datasets, with a particular emphasis on the Feynman-AI benchmark.

However, these systems often experience performance degradation over time due to an outdated knowledge base, highlighting the need for periodic updates.

This study investigates the surface morphology and elemental distribution of silicon nitride fibers through TEM and EDS, and SEM and EDS analyses.

The material merges the properties of interconnected cryogel structure in adsorbing molecules via fast diffusion flux, with the strong electrostatic interactions acted by imidazole moiety.

pmc-12372218.description: Background and objectiveDelivering therapeutic drugs to the brain for neurological disorders remains challenging due to the restrictive nature of the blood–brain barrier (BBB). pmc-12457830.creator: Yenna Hsu, Jiajing Yang, Miaoyang Cao, Ting Xu, Jia He, Huarong Hong, Luyun Jiang, Shunlin Peng, Peizheng Xiong

pmc-12573718.title: Landscape and Climate‐Associated Selection in the Native and Widespread Bumblebee, Bombus terrestris
pmc-12573718.creator: Cecilia Kardum Hjort, Rachael Y Dudaniec, Peter Olsson, Johan Ekroos, Henrik G Smith
pmc-12573718.description: Anthropogenic land‐use and climate change pose novel selection pressures on bees, yet their evolutionary responses in terms of morphological or physiological adaptations remain unclear. While adaptive responses are expected, these may be constrained by gene flow when changes in selection pressures are spatially heterogeneous.

pmc-13050135.title: Human Immunodeficiency Virus-Associated Vasculitis: A Case Report of Sensorineural Hearing Loss, Bell's Palsy, and Psoriasis Guttata
pmc-13050135.creator: Beatriz Simão-Parreira, Adriana Costa, Henrique Cerveira, Jorge Almeida, Leila Cardoso
pmc-13050135.description: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection can manifest with diverse and nonspecific symptoms, often delaying diagnosis. Neurological and autoimmune complications have been associated with HIV-induced immune dysregulation. Although HIV-associated vasculitis is rare, its recognition is crucial due to its potential impact on disease progression and management.

pmc-13169873.title: Latent profiles of psychopathological and criminological characteristics in prisoners: associations with suicide risk
pmc-13169873.creator: Jue Deng, Jianping Ma, Yuanhua Ou, Liqin Lu, Jianhan Cai, Xiaoli Zhu
pmc-13169873.description: BackgroundPrison suicide continues to be a global public health concern. Based on the stress-diathesis model, there may be interactions between psychopathological vulnerabilities and criminological stressors that contribute to suicide risk. However, no prior studies have empirically elucidated how these factors jointly configure distinct risk profiles among prisoners.

pmc-13181660.title: Doctor-child communication and caregivers’ willingness to recommend hospital: a secondary analysis using pediatric patient experience data
pmc-13181660.creator: Hao Huang, Weina Shang, Ming Zhu, Guangyu Hu
pmc-13181660.description: BackgroundDoctor-child communication is central to pediatric care, yet current research often marginalizes child-centered interactions and fails to isolate which specific behaviors drive systemic hospital metrics. This study addresses these gaps by using The Child Hospital Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (Child HCAHPS) framework to deconstruct communication into three discrete behaviors.

pmc-13390079.title: Amplified P-wave duration predicts incident atrial fibrillation in the general population: Results from the Hamburg City Health Study

pmc-13390079.description: BackgroundClinical risk factors identify subjects at risk of incident atrial fibrillation (AF) with only mediocre accuracy. Amplified P-wave duration (PWD) is a novel electrocardiographic (ECG) marker for conduction delay in atrial cardiomyopathy, which in turn is associated with AF.ObjectiveThis study aimed to assess whether amplified PWD can predict incident AF in the general population.

pmc-13522854.creator: Matthieu Vincenot, Maxime Roberge, Charles‐Édouard Giguère, Stéphane Potvin
pmc-13522854.description: BackgroundPain perception is the result of different modulatory mechanisms. Inhibition, via descending brainstem mechanisms, is key to pain reduction and is typically elicited by the cold pressor test (CPT). Recently, a compensatory hedonic response has been observed after CPT interruption, thought to facilitate return to homeostasis.
